summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from RIT. Built ML training pipelines and data curation systems across seven projects including CUDA kernel optimization, SLM quantization, CARLA autonomous driving data generation, and voice-controlled robotic arm integration. Experienced in PyTorch model training, real-world data cleaning, and metrics-driven evaluation for robotics and edge deployment.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT transformer on medical billing dataset using PyTorch and HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder, improving accuracy from 55% to 93%
Built training pipelines with domain-specific tokens and resized decoder embedding layer

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated 1,133-image dataset for YOLOv8 health classification; trained YOLOv8n achieving 83% mAP@50, exported to ONNX and TFLite

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed custom wavelet bank (sym6+bior3.5) with optimized homography stitching achieving PSNR of 86; deployed ZoeDepth for crack-depth profiling at ±8% error
Architected metal surface inspection pipeline using image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built voice-controlled vision-guided robotic pick-and-place over three-layer pipeline: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO server, Jetson+Arduino via WebSocket fabric
Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent (<500ms), TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup) for visual servoing, dual VL53L0X ToF for contact-aware grasping
Resolved 11 integration failures; 100% pick reliability (10/10) at ~11.5s latency; built LeRobot multi-camera data collection with multiprocessing

projects.name: CARLA Autonomous Driving Pipeline
bullets: Built automated data pipelines using CARLA semantic segmentation generating ~8,000 frames with zero manual annotation
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and UFLD (ResNet-18) in adaptive control stack; zero collisions in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory, preallocated buffers; ~35% speedup (49.2ms vs 73.3ms)

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory by ~55% via 8-bit quantization on TinyLlama 1.1B; <1% accuracy drop across HellaSwag, GSM8K, ARC
